title: Merchandise Purchases — Payments Reconciliation Sheet for the Duplicate-Capture Refund
content:
Payments reconciliation sets the duplicate-capture refund on a Merchandise Purchases unit by the following clauses.

**C1 Second capture refunded.** The amount of the unit's latest payment capture when the tender of that capture was captured more than once for the unit, and nothing otherwise.

**C2 Held-capture days.** The calendar days from the date of the latest capture to the request date, not counting the capture date, rounded down to a whole number of weeks and multiplied by seven.

**C3 Held-capture credit.** The daily held-capture rate of $0.25 times the held-capture days; it never exceeds the held-capture cap of $2.00.

**C4 Allowances and goodwill.** The bank-fee allowance is $0.00, the member spend goodwill is $0.00, and the capture-size goodwill is $2.00.

**C5 Refund.** The second capture plus the capped held-capture credit plus the bank-fee allowance plus the member spend goodwill plus the capture-size goodwill, rounded half up to the cent.

## Reconciliation example (hypothetical figures)

Debit captures of $64.80 on 3 May and $64.80 on 5 May for one unit; request on 26 May.

| Clause | Working | Figure |
|---|---|---|
| C1 | latest capture $64.80; debit captured twice | $64.80 |
| C2 | 21 days after 5 May, exactly 3 whole weeks | 21 |
| C3 | $0.25 times 21 is $5.25, held at $2.00 | $2.00 |
| C4 | allowance, member goodwill, size goodwill | $0.00, $0.00, $2.00 |
| C5 | $64.80 plus $2.00 plus $0.00 plus $0.00 plus $2.00 | $68.80 |

## Other inputs worked through C1 and C2 (hypothetical)

- A unit paid by gift card and then by debit, each captured once: the latest capture's tender (debit) was captured once, so the second capture refunded is nothing.
- A request 6 days after the latest capture: 0 whole weeks, so 0 held-capture days and no held-capture credit.
